title: Creamy Cod with Garlic
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring cod cooked in a creamy garlic sauce.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place cod fillets on the baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the cod is baking, heat the creamy sauce in a pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Serve the cod with the creamy garlic sauce spooned over the top.
